# Introduction

Six male participants underwent 1 hr endurance exercise (~70% VO2 peak) with skeletal muscle
biopsy before and immediately after exercise.
These skeletal muscle samples underwent mRNA-seq, and ChIP-seq for H3K9/K14ac and H3K36ac.
The goal is to understand the coordination between RNA expression and histone acetylation,
and also to characterise the pathway expression changes.
Gene expression was quantified using STAR uniquely mapped reads and promoter based histone
acetylation changes were quantified by read counting within 3 kbp of the TSS.
In this analysis we will perform correlation analysis between these omics and conduct a
multivariate REACTOME pathway enrichment analysis.

```{r,install,eval = FALSE}

if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("mitch")

```

```{r,libs}

library("mitch")
library("eulerr")
library("kableExtra")

```

## Obtain REACTOME gene sets

```{r,genesets}

if ( ! file.exists("data/ReactomePathways_2025-09-02.gmt") ) {
  download.file("https://ziemann-lab.net/public/bioinfo_workshop/2026/ReactomePathways_2025-09-02.gmt",
  destfile="data/ReactomePathways_2025-09-02.gmt")
}

gs <- gmt_import("data/ReactomePathways_2025-09-02.gmt")

head(gs,3)

```

## Get omics data

DE analysis has already been done.
But let's look at the MDS plots.
Check http://10.11.41.249/public/exercise_histone/

```{r,fetchdata}

K9URL="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/markziemann/bioinformatics_intro_workshop/refs/heads/2026/data/k9a.tsv"
K36URL="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/markziemann/bioinformatics_intro_workshop/refs/heads/2026/data/k36a.tsv"
RNAURL="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/markziemann/bioinformatics_intro_workshop/refs/heads/2026/data/rna.tsv"

```

## Import differential expression data

```{r,mds,fig.width=6,fig.height=6}

if ( ! file.exists("data/k9a.tsv") ) {
  download.file(K9URL,"k9a.tsv")
}

if ( ! file.exists("data/k36a.tsv") ) {
  download.file(K36URL,"k35a.tsv")
}

if ( ! file.exists("data/rna.tsv") ) {
  download.file(RNAURL,"rna.tsv")
}


rna <- read.table("data/rna.tsv",header=TRUE,row.names = 1)
head(rna)

k9a <- read.table("data/k9a.tsv",header=TRUE,row.names = 1)
head(k9a)

k36a <- read.table("data/k36a.tsv",header=TRUE,row.names = 1)
head(k36a)

```

## Euler diagrams

```{r,euler}

rna_up <- rownames(subset(rna,adj.p.value<0.05 & logFC > 0))
rna_dn <- rownames(subset(rna,adj.p.value<0.05 & logFC < 0))

k9a_up <- rownames(subset(k9a,adj.p.value<0.05 & logFC > 0))
k9a_dn <- rownames(subset(k9a,adj.p.value<0.05 & logFC < 0))

k36a_up <- rownames(subset(k36a,adj.p.value<0.05 & logFC > 0))
k36a_dn <- rownames(subset(k36a,adj.p.value<0.05 & logFC < 0))

xl <- list("RNA up"=rna_up, "RNA dn"=rna_dn,
  "K9a up"=k9a_up, "K9a dn"=k9a_dn,
  "K36a up"=k36a_up, "K36a dn"=k36a_dn )

plot(euler(xl),quantities = list(cex = 2), labels = list(cex = 2))

v1 <- list("RNA up"=rna_up, "K9a up"=k9a_up, "K36a up"=k36a_up)

plot(euler(v1),quantities = list(cex = 2), labels = list(cex = 2))

v2 <- list("RNA dn"=rna_dn, "K9a dn"=k9a_dn, "K36a dn"=k36a_dn)

plot(euler(v2),quantities = list(cex = 2), labels = list(cex = 2))

```
## Mitch import

This combines the DE data into a single metric, good for comparing across contrasts.

```{r,import,fig.height=8,fig.width=8}

x <- list("rna"=rna,"k9a"=k9a,"k36a"=k36a)
xx <- mitch_import(x = x,DEtype = "edger")

head(xx)
dim(xx)
cor(xx)
cor(xx,method="spearman")

```

## Perform enrichment analysis

```{r,enrichment}

res <- mitch_calc(x = xx,genesets = gs, priority = "effect",cores=4, resrows=10)

head(res$enrichment_result,30) %>%
  kbl(caption="Top pathways by Enrichment Score") %>%
  kable_paper("hover", full_width = F)

if ( file.exists("exercise_reactome_report.html") ) {
  unlink("exercise_reactome_report.html")
}
mitch_report(res = res, outfile = "exercise_reactome_report.html")

```
